## How to Enable Stock Photos for Single Image Posts


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097799

Single-Image Posts such as blog articles, jobs, or events, ( Single-Image Posts vs Multi-Image Posts) now have the option to use the stock photo libraries to select their images. To enable this feature, go to Advanced Settings and check the following option under Froala Enable Stock Photo Library:

Once the option has been enabled, using the Stock Libraries will become enabled for Single Image Posts:

Clicking on this button will open up the following options:
